build_CountingIterator: build a CountingIterator wrapper that tracks iteration count and supports skip and take operations
build_EpochBatchIterator: build an EpochBatchIterator for multi-epoch dataset iteration with sharding and state serialization
build_GroupedIterator: build a GroupedIterator that chunks items into groups of a specified size with remainder handling
build_ShardedIterator: build a ShardedIterator that splits an iterable into N shards for distributed data loading
build_BufferedIterator: build a BufferedIterator with a background consumer thread that preloads data into a queue
